scope: Independent Eqs.(1),(11) enumeration on pinned csi2008 numerical input. Validate production calculation, all 20 ordered-position contributions and Eq.(2) on a complete cube. NOT a claim to reproduce the Figure4 gamma_star result or its original input.
preprocessing: Full 32-genotype biallelic 5-site landscape; natural log of supplied positive W/MIC; maximize. All 640 directed focal/background substitution pairs on 80 complete squares; pool products and squares with equal directed-pair weights. Exact ties have sign zero and remain in the square population. No epsilon, imputation, significance filter, subsampling, variance inference or RNG.

sources.locator: Published version Section 2.1 Eq.(1), Section 2.5 Eqs.(10)-(12), and Fig.4c on p.138. Eq.(12) assumes no neutral mutations.
Table1 pp.32-33: CS I displayed w values. This earlier rounded table is a separate input, not substituted for the 2011 values.

comparison.justification: Agreement with independently enumerated directed-substitution equations on fixed source data; numeric roundoff only. These are not published numerical targets.
